resources.string: Choose the balance between map fluidity and battery life.
How do you want to use Roadstr?
Choose the performance level that best suits your device and preferences. You can change it at any time in Settings.
Maximum battery life. Uses the 2D map at up to 30 FPS, reducing animations and unnecessary updates. Ideal for long trips and less powerful devices.
Smooth navigation with contained energy use. Uses the 2D map at up to 60 FPS. Ideal for mid-range phones.
Optimized 3D navigation. Uses MapLibre at up to 45 FPS with more frequent lightweight updates. Ideal for 3D without sustained maximum performance.
Maximum fluidity. Uses MapLibre at up to 60 FPS and high-frequency lightweight updates. Ideal for more powerful devices.
GPS: 1 Hz, adaptively up to 2 Hz
GPS: up to 2 Hz while navigating
